subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should existing project `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` files above 1 MiB be deliberately excluded from session context on upgrade, or must the hardening preserve their current loading contract through a different bounded policy?
rationale: The branch changes an established session-context input from loading without a size limit to being omitted above a fixed threshold; selecting the permanent upgrade behavior is a maintainer product and compatibility decision, not a mechanical repair choice.

options.title: Approve strict 1 MiB context cap
options.body: Keep the 1 MiB rejection behavior, document the upgrade impact and recovery path, and require descriptor-level bounded reading before merge.

options.title: Preserve existing context compatibility
options.body: Choose a bounded loading policy that does not newly omit existing oversized project context, while retaining a real memory-safety limit.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing context compatibility
recommendation.body: Choose a bounded loading policy that does not newly omit existing oversized project context, while retaining a real memory-safety limit.
